# ABINIT fixtures

`si.abi` and `si.abo` are copied unmodified from *httk-workflow-abinit*'s
`tests/data`: a serial ABINIT 10.0.3 SCF run of diamond silicon generated by
this project. `si.abo` is ABINIT program output of that run. The
pseudopotential used for the run is not copied (it is GPL-licensed and not
needed to read the geometry).
